bot.title: iOiO Assistant
bot.sub: Answers on offices, pricing and availability
bot.footer: Powered by Gemini · indexes site pages and documents published in the back office
bot.footerLocal: Answers taken from the site pages and the documents published in the back office
bot.greeting: Hello! I am the iOiO assistant. I search the site pages and the documents published in the back office. {count} desks are free right now. What would you like to know?
bot.fallback: I have no document on that specific point yet. I am passing the question to the team: leave your email in the contact form and you will get an answer within 24 working hours.
bot.error: The assistant is temporarily unavailable. Write to us: you will get an answer within 24 working hours.
bot.throttled: You have asked a lot of questions in a row. Let us pick this up in a few minutes, or write to us directly.
exit.title: Hold the desk you like for 48 hours.
exit.sub: Leave your email and we send you real availability, all-inclusive pricing and two viewing slots. No sales chasing.
exit.sent: Noted! You will receive the availability list in a few minutes.
footer.about: All-inclusive coworking and office rental in central Besançon. Two renovated spaces made for freelancers and small teams.
error.404Text: This page does not exist or has moved. Let us start again from the home page or the office list.
error.500Text: The site hit a problem. The team has been notified: please try again in a moment.
consent.title: Your choice
consent.text: This site needs no advertising cookies. We only ask for your agreement on audience measurement and on the assistant, which sends your questions to Google.
consent.panelText: You can change your mind at any time from the « Cookies » link at the bottom of the page.
consent.necessaryText: Anti-spam session for the forms, chosen language, memory of windows you already closed. The site does not work without them, so they require no consent.
consent.analyticsText: Counts visits in aggregate so we know which pages are useful. Rejected, no measurement script is loaded.
consent.aiText: Your questions are sent to Google to write the answer. Rejected, the assistant answers only from the site pages and documents, with nothing sent outside.
